title: ZoomInfo: The Go-To-Market Platform - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 21]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, we will be breaking down ZoomInfo.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we will be breaking down ZoomInfo. Founded as DiscoverOrg in 2007, ZoomInfo is a go-to-market software & data solution for B2B sales. When a sales rep gains access to ZoomInfo, they gain access to a database with over 130 million contacts.

key_points.text: The ZoomInfo platform assists in finding potential customers, contacting those potential customers, and refining each phase of the workflow.
To help break down ZoomInfo, host Jesse Pujji is joined by its CEO, Henry Schuck.
Henry founded DiscoverOrg and acquired ZoomInfo in 2019.
